STUDENT GUIDE / 2025\'9626
\
Scheme Guide
\
\
\
Competition/Award Subsidy Scheme
for PolyU Design Students
\
Scheme period \'b7 September 2025 to August 2026
\
\
\
\
On this page
\
\
\
01 / Funding coverage
\
\
\
02 / Eligibility
\
\
\
03 / Competition scope and registration
\
\
\
04 / Annual quotas and exclusions
\
\
\

\
\
\

\
\
\
\
\
\
01 / Funding coverage
\
\
\
Competition entrance fee
\
Full reimbursement of the entrance fee per entry
\
\
\
Shipping of prototypes or other materials
\
Up to HK$1,000
\
\
\
\
\
02 / Eligibility
\
Who can apply?
\
1. Current students
\
You may apply if you are a current student at PolyU School of Design in one of the following categories:
\
\
\
BA (Hons) Scheme in Design
\
Year 1 students
\
\
\
Clusters
\
Communication Design, Environment Design, Product Experience Design or Service Design
\
\
\
Specialisms in BA (Hons)
\
Advertising Design, Information Design, Media Design, Environmental Design, Interior Design, Interaction Design, Product Design, Service Design or Social Design
\
\
\
2. Recent graduates
\
You may apply if you meet all three of the following conditions:
\
\
1. You graduated from an eligible PolyU School of Design undergraduate programme or specialism.
\
2. You graduated within one year of the application date.
\
3. You are submitting a school project to a recognised competition.
\
\
3. Inbound exchange students
\
Inbound exchange students are not eligible.
\
\
\
03 / Competition scope and registration
\
\
International competitions
\
International competitions and awards are given priority. The scheme considers competitions on its reference list and other internationally recognised competitions.
\
\
\
Local competitions
\
Local competitions and awards may be considered based on their scale and reputation.
\
\
\
School affiliation
\
School affiliation must be stated in your competition registration. Indicate that you or your project are affiliated with PolyU School of Design.
\
\
\
\
04 / Annual quotas and exclusions
\
\
Annual quotas
\
Each eligible category has an annual quota. Programme or Specialism Leaders can ask the SD Marketing Team for the remaining quota.
\
\
\
Other funding
\
An entry is ineligible if it receives financial support from another School of Design programme, a PolyU unit or an external party.
\
\
\
Expenses not covered
\
Printing, production, publishing, credit card charges and other bank fees are not reimbursable.
\
\
\
\
05 / Application and reimbursement process
\
\
\
1
\
\
\
Submit your application
\
Complete the application form and upload it together with your competition work. Before submitting, select the relevant Programme Leader or designated delegate as your endorser. For entries resulting from interdisciplinary work, you may select the relevant Subject Leader.
\
\
\
\
Group entries\
\
For a group entry, one student representative who paid the relevant fees submits the application on behalf of the group and provides all required information.
\
\
\
\
2
\
\
\
Await academic endorsement
\
The portal automatically sends your application form and competition work to the relevant Programme, Cluster or Specialism Leader, or a designated delegate, for endorsement.
\
\
\
\
\
3
\
\
\
Await the application outcome
\
Once your application is endorsed, the SD Marketing Team verifies the submitted information and notifies both you and your endorser of the application result.
\
\
\
\
\
4
\
\
\
After approval
\
Submit reimbursement details. Upload copies of the payment receipts for the entrance fee and/or shipping fee, and provide your bank account information through the portal.
Report your competition results. Inform the SD Marketing Team of the competition or award result through the portal within one month of its official announcement.
\
\
\

01 / Roles in the scheme
\
\
\
Academic Endorser
\
Assess the competition and the submitted entry. Record and submit your academic endorsement decision.
\
\
\
SD Marketing Team
\
After endorsement, verify applicant eligibility and the submitted information. Notify the applicant and endorser of the application outcome.
\
\
\
\
\
02 / Who can endorse
\
The Programme Leader or a designated delegate may provide endorsement.
\
The scheme\'92s application procedure also lists Cluster and Specialism Leaders.
\
\
Interdisciplinary work
\
For entries resulting from interdisciplinary work, the relevant Subject Leader may provide endorsement.
\
\
\
\
03 / Competition priority
\
\
International competitions and awards
\
The scheme gives priority to international competitions and awards.
\
\
\
Local competitions and awards
\
Local competitions and awards may be considered based on their scale and reputation.
\
\
\

\
